description: Smart-search filters for the Onhand Quantity tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Not offered: minQty/maxQty — a numeric range needs a filter type this app does not have. The Yard chip shows the yard NAME but sends invOrgId; these rows carry both.
